scripts.build:android: expo prebuild --platform android --clean && printf "sdk.dir=$HOME/Library/Android/sdk\n" > android/local.properties && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:android:mac: export JAVA_17=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 17) && echo Using JAVA_17=$JAVA_17 && ($JAVA_17/bin/java -version 2>&1 | head -n1 | grep '"17' > /dev/null) || (echo 'ERROR: JDK 17 not found. Install with: brew install --cask temurin@17' && exit 1); JAVA_HOME=$JAVA_17 ORG_GRADLE_JAVA_HOME=$JAVA_17 npx expo prebuild --platform android --clean && printf "sdk.dir=$HOME/Library/Android/sdk\n" > android/local.properties && cd android && JAVA_HOME=$JAVA_17 ORG_GRADLE_JAVA_HOME=$JAVA_17 ./gradlew --no-daemon -Dorg.gradle.java.home=$JAVA_17 assembleDebug
scripts.build:ios: expo prebuild --platform ios --clean && cd ios && pod install && xcodebuild -workspace $(ls | grep .xcworkspace) -scheme hamaki -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 15' build
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:android && npm run build:ios
